subproblem.title: Corollary 8.5.7 (tangent cones are rectifiable cones), from the sibling results
subproblem.statement: Assume VarifoldTangentCones, the blow-up density lower bound (second conjunct of the sibling varifold_tangents), AllardRectifiabilityTheorem and FirstRectifiabilityTheorem. The blow-up density lower bound says: if V has locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, τ > 0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ ofReal τ)}) → 0, then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) has Θ^n(μ_C,·) ≥ ofReal τ μ_C-a.e. Then TangentConesAreRectifiableCones holds. That is, let V have locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, Θ^n(μ_V,x) = θ0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ 1)}) → 0. Then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is rectifiable and rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure for all s > 0.
subproblem.lean_statement: VarifoldTangentCones → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → 0 < τ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ) → AllardRectifiabilityTheorem → FirstRectifiabilityTheorem → TangentConesAreRectifiableCones
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon 8.5.7 and its printed proof (p. 216), i.e. Steps B1–B2 of the supplied proof. Step B3 is the sibling child tangent_point_representation and Steps B4–B6 are the sibling child cone_rescaling_invariance (Lean: Submission.allard_tc_tangent_point_representation, Submission.allard_tc_cone_rescaling_invariance). As in the contract, "{y ∈ B_ρ(x) : Θ^n(μ_V,y) < 1}" is read as the set where "Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and is ≥ 1" fails. 5.3 is used in its corrected form μ_C(sA) = s^nμ_C(A).

1. Let N, n, U, V, x and θ0 satisfy: V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, HasDensity n μ_V x (ofReal θ0), 5.1 (ofReal ρ·‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/ofReal(ρ)^n → 0), and the decay hypothesis for the set where "∃ θ, HasDensity n μ_V y θ ∧ 1 ≤ θ" fails. Let C ∈ VarTan(V,x), i.e. IsVarifoldTangent V x C.

2. Step B1: "From the hypothesis … and the Semi-continuity 3.7, Θ^n(μ_C,y) ≥ 1 for μ_C-a.e. y". Since ENNReal.ofReal 1 = 1, the decay hypothesis is the decay hypothesis of the blow-up density lower bound with τ = 1. Applying the lower bound to (N, n, U, V, x, 1), with hV, x ∈ U, 0 < 1, 5.1, the decay, C and C ∈ VarTan(V,x), gives: for μ_C-a.e. y there is θ with HasDensity n μ_C y θ and 1 ≤ θ. In particular θ > 0.

3. Step B2: "Hence by 5.5 C is n-rectifiable". VarifoldTangentCones(N, n, U, V, x, θ0), part (b), applied to C gives that C is stationary and satisfies (Hom): μ_C(s•A) = ofReal(s)^n·μ_C(A) for all s > 0 and A. Stationary varifolds have locally bounded first variation (SimonGMT Varifold.Stationary.hasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation). So AllardRectifiabilityTheorem(N, n, univ, C) applies, with the a.e. positive density of step 2. It gives IsRectifiable C, the first conclusion, and (T): for μ_C-a.e. y there are T and θ with HasTangentPlane C y T θ.

4. Step B3: canonical representation. tangent_point_representation(FirstRectifiabilityTheorem, N, n, C, (T)) gives M and θ with IsVarifoldOf C M θ, HasTangentPlane at every point of M with multiplicity θ, and (★): C(A) = ∫⁻ over {x ∈ M : ∃ T, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x) ∧ (x,T) ∈ A} of ofReal θ dH^n for every Borel A.

5. Steps B4–B6: "and hence η_{0,λ#}C = C". cone_rescaling_invariance(N, n, C, M, θ), applied with the three facts of step 4 and (Hom), gives rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure for every s > 0. This is the second conclusion. ∎
proof_key_steps: B1: the blow-up density lower bound with τ = 1 (ofReal 1 = 1) gives Θ(μ_C,·) ≥ 1 μ_C-a.e.
B2: VarifoldTangentCones(b) makes C stationary (hence LBFV) with μ_C(sA) = s^nμ_C(A); AllardRectifiabilityTheorem on C gives IsRectifiable C and tangent planes μ_C-a.e.
B3: tangent_point_representation gives (M, θ) with IsVarifoldOf, tangent planes on M and the representation (★).
B4–B6: cone_rescaling_invariance gives rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure for s > 0.

audit.reason: The lower-density bound at τ=1 and tangent-cone stationarity justify applying the explicit Allard hypothesis. The two declared children then establish rescaling invariance.
